content.caption:
Bikepacking offline navigation: 3 backups, zero signal needed.

Signal drops in the best places. A calm plan beats a stressed scroll.

1. Download maps, GPX and your plan at home on wifi. Test it in airplane mode.
2. Carry a backup: a paper map, or a second device with the same GPX.
3. Keep a power bank handy so your screen stays alive.

BikepackPilot is a web app that works offline and installs like an app.
